full_text:
ADDENDUM <Rule No. 1007, July 21, 2023>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Period of Validity)
These Rules shall remain effective for five years from the date of their promulgation.

Article 3 (Applicability to Goods Subject to Anti-Dumping Measures during the Review Period)
These Rules shall apply beginning with goods for which import declarations were filed on or after November 29, 2022.
